item.title: How I got over 300 Tor exit nodes removed
item.description:
📝 The Attack The attack appears to have had two primary goals: Gather as much unencrypted mail traffic as possible Intercept SSH connections (MITM) By blocking certain ports, they made their exit nodes handle only unencrypted mail traffic. Sun Oct 4: The Tor network health team made an announcement to the operators, who began shutting their exit nodes down. Server B checked whether the connection came from the pinned exit node or from one of the 12 SSH interception servers.
🔗 Read more: https://kaba.cx/posts/20261020_Tor/
